games.title: Lane Dodge
games.short_description: Switch across three lanes, dodge falling blocks, and survive the accelerating pace for a higher score.
games.description: Lane Dodge is a fast mobile-friendly survival game built around instant decisions. Move between three lanes, avoid falling blocks as the pace accelerates, chase a higher score, and jump straight into another run or a friend challenge after failure.

games.title: Stack Drop
games.short_description: Time each drop, keep the overlap, and build the tallest block tower you can in a one-tap stacking challenge.
games.description: Stack Drop is a short-session one-tap stacking game. Drop each moving block onto the tower, preserve as much overlap as possible, and keep climbing until a miss ends the run. The loop is designed for quick retries, score chasing, and shareable friend challenges.

games.title: Tile Shift
games.short_description: Slide numbered tiles into order and clear as many compact 3x3 boards as possible in 60 seconds.
games.description: Tile Shift compresses the classic sliding-number puzzle into a 60-second score sprint. Move numbered tiles into order, clear one compact 3x3 board after another, and try to beat your board-clear record before the timer expires. It is mobile-friendly and built for immediate replay.

games.title: Grid Toggle
games.short_description: Toggle tiles and their neighbors to turn the full grid dark, clearing as many logic boards as possible in 60 seconds.
games.description: Grid Toggle is a rapid lights-style logic puzzle. Tap a tile to flip it and its neighbors, solve guaranteed-solvable boards, and clear as many grids as possible before the 60-second timer ends. The format is compact, mobile-friendly, and built for fast replay and score comparison.
